captions.detailed: This 3D model features a mechanical branching assembly resembling a stylized industrial tree. It consists of a dark gray central vertical column mounted on a wide, rectangular H-shaped base plate. The top of the column supports a thick, cubical main housing with open side windows, which acts as the central hub. Extending from opposite sides of this housing are two independent, light gray branch arms mounted on rotating shafts with split bearing carriers, stop tabs, and mounting plates, allowing them to swing pivotally in a revolute motion.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D mechanical branching assembly in CadQuery with two independent rotating arms. The assembly should feature a central structural vertical column on an H-shaped base, a hollowed-out cubical hub at the top, and two independent branch arms mounted on separate horizontal shafts with split bearing carriers and stop tabs. Apply a dark gray finish to the main support frame and a lighter gray to the rotating mechanical arm components.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model using a multi-part assembly. First, the base is created by modeling an H-shaped plate with mounting holes. Next, the vertical column is extruded with internal hollowed-out channels. The top housing is built from a modified solid cube with cutouts to serve as a central node. The two rotating branch arms are constructed using angled rectangular extrusions, complete with cylindrical pivot shafts, split bearing blocks, and end flanges. These components are positioned using rigid transformation matrices and assembled with revolute joints to define their independent axes of rotation.
